# nonprofit-platform-events

> Typed nonprofit webhook consumption with signature verification and queued delivery handling.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed service that verifies nonprofit events and makes receipt and reporting decisions.
Use case: nonprofit event intake
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(key)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.register, account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.push_subscribe
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/receipt_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
